faqs.question: How long does a Diwali status stay on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: 24 hours from when you post it. WhatsApp's About status help page says a status disappears after that and that status cannot be turned off, so a line posted at 7 pm on Diwali, 29 October 2027, is gone at 7 pm the next day.

faqs.question: Is there a character limit for a text status on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp's help pages publish no character limit for a text status as of October 2026. The 30 lines on this page run from 32 to 83 characters, short enough to read at a glance on a phone.

faqs.question: How long can my Diwali video status be?
faqs.answer: Up to 90 seconds, in 3GP or MPEG-4 format, according to WhatsApp's About status page read on 22 October 2026. Trim a longer aarti or diya-lighting clip before you post it.

faqs.question: Can I hide my Diwali status from certain people?
faqs.answer: Yes. In Updates, open Status privacy and choose My contacts except… to leave people out, or Only share with… to pick a short list. The change applies only to statuses you post after making it.

faqs.question: What time should I put up my Diwali status in 2027?
faqs.answer: Post it on the evening of Friday 29 October 2027, as the Lakshmi Puja diyas are lit. It will stay up until the same time on Saturday 30 October, which is Govardhan Puja and the Gujarati New Year.

faqs.question: Should I post a Hindi status in Devanagari or Roman script?
faqs.answer: Use Devanagari if most of your contacts read Hindi, and Roman script if your list is mixed. Each Hindi line on this page gives both, plus an English meaning, so you can choose per audience.

faqs.question: Can people tell that I viewed their Diwali status?
faqs.answer: Not if you have turned read receipts off. WhatsApp's status privacy page says a sender cannot see whether a contact viewed their status when that contact has disabled read receipts.

faqs.question: Can I share my WhatsApp Diwali status to Instagram too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Status privacy has Facebook Story and Instagram Story toggles that copy each status automatically. The copy then follows your existing story privacy settings on those apps, not your WhatsApp audience.

faqs.question: Can I mention someone in my Diwali status?
faqs.answer: In a photo or video status, yes: WhatsApp allows up to 5 private mentions, and the people you mention can reshare it. You cannot mention anyone in a text or voice status for now.

faqs.question: Should I post one Diwali status or one for each festival day?
faqs.answer: Each status lasts 24 hours, so one posted on Dhanteras, Wednesday 27 October 2027, expires before Lakshmi Puja night. To mark all five days, post a short new line each evening.

faqs.question: Does SubhSandesh post a Diwali status for me?
faqs.answer: No. The Happy Diwali template makes a private page for one person, opened by link in any browser with no app or account. The Shubh Deepavali card at its end can be saved as a 1080×1920 image, which the recipient can post as a status themselves.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Diwali Status Lines for WhatsApp, Sorted by Length and Tone

A Diwali status works best as one line you wrote yourself, posted on the evening of Lakshmi Puja: Friday 29 October 2027, or Sunday 8 November in 2026. WhatsApp removes every status after 24 hours, so a line posted at 7 pm on Diwali is gone at 7 pm the next day.

Below are 30 original Diwali status lines in English, Hindi and Hinglish, each with its character count, then audience settings, format limits and when not to post one. Two SubhSandesh numbers shape the advice: in Raksha Bandhan 2026, our nearest festival analogue (n = 89 pages), 49.4% of greeting pages were built on the festival day itself and 27.0% the day before. And 48.3% of shared SubhSandesh pages are opened on a phone, so every line here was written to be read on one.

## What is a Diwali status, and how long does it last?

A Diwali status is a short festive update, in text, photo, video or GIF form, posted to WhatsApp's Updates tab rather than one chat. WhatsApp's [About status help page](https://faq.whatsapp.com/454876960047011/) says these updates disappear after 24 hours and that status cannot be turned off.

The same page, read on 22 October 2026, caps a video status at 90 seconds. It publishes no character limit for a text status, so the counts below are a reading guide, not a rule.

## 30 original Diwali status lines, by length and tone

Every line was written for this page. The bracketed number is the character count, spaces and punctuation included.

### 1. Under 40 characters, for a one-glance status

Short lines suit a photo status, where the picture does the work. They also suit anyone who posts once a year.

- "Lamps lit. Phone down. Happy Diwali." (36)
- "Mithai first, resolutions later. 🪔" (34)
- "Our gali is glowing. How's yours?" (33)
- "One diya for every unsent thank-you." (36)
- "Ghar saaf. Dil saaf. Happy Diwali." (34)

### 2. Warm lines for family, 40 to 90 characters

Naming a specific person or job in the house makes a family status feel written, not forwarded. Post one over a photo of the actual rangoli.

- "Ma's diyas, Didi's playlist, my job was holding the ladder. Shubh Deepavali." (76)
- "Same diyas as last year, two more faces at the door. Shubh Deepavali." (69)
- "Fresh paint, ghee in the kadhai, every relative on speaker. It's Diwali." (72)
- "Grandpa's old brass diya came out of the trunk again. Shubh Deepavali." (70)
- "Phone calls from three cities before the puja even started. Shubh Deepavali." (76)

### 3. Playful lines for friends and the group chat

With friends, a line that laughs at yourself does what a formal blessing cannot. Keep it clean: your default audience is every contact, aunties included.

- "Diwali scoreboard: 4 homes visited, 11 kinds of namkeen, 0 regrets." (67)
- "Formal notice: I will be at your place for the leftovers." (57)
- "If my status is late, assume I'm stuck in a relative's drawing room." (68)
- "Reply with your favourite Diwali snack, purely for research purposes." (69)
- "Still waiting for the cousin who said 'five minutes' at 7 pm." (61)

### 4. Lines for a Diwali away from home

For hostel students, shift workers and families abroad, the honest status is the small one. These run 60 to 68 characters.

- "Diwali on a video call still counts. Lamps lit at both ends." (60)
- "Ten time zones away, one diya on the windowsill. Happy Diwali, home." (68)
- "Hostel room, one candle, Ma on speaker. Best Diwali I could manage." (67)
- "Missing the noise, keeping the light. Shubh Deepavali from afar." (64)
- "The courier box of sweets tastes exactly like home. Thank you, Ma." (66)

### 5. Diwali status in Hindi

Each line is in Devanagari, then Roman script, then English. Post the Devanagari alone for Hindi readers.

- "दीये जले, दिल खिले, शुभ दीपावली।" (32): Diye jale, dil khile, Shubh Deepavali (lamps lit, hearts opened, a blessed Deepavali).
- "घर में रोशनी, मन में सुकून, बस इतना चाहिए।" (42): Ghar mein roshni, man mein sukoon, bas itna chahiye (light at home, calm inside, nothing more needed).
- "पटाखे कम, मुलाक़ातें ज़्यादा, यही दिवाली।" (41): Patakhe kam, mulaqaatein zyada, yahi Diwali (fewer crackers, more visits, that is Diwali).
- "इस दिवाली कोई गिला नहीं, सिर्फ़ मिठाई।" (38): Is Diwali koi gila nahin, sirf mithai (no grudges this Diwali, only sweets).
- "वीडियो कॉल पर आरती, आवाज़ कटती रही, फिर भी पूरी।" (48): Video call par aarti, awaaz kat-ti rahi, phir bhi poori (aarti on a video call, sound cutting out, still whole).

### 6. Neutral lines for a mixed contact list

Colleagues, landlords and school groups see the same line, so these assume nothing about faith. Diwali week in 2027 also holds Bandi Chhor Divas for many Sikhs and the Gujarati New Year on Saturday 30 October.

- "Diyas at the door, chai on the stove, everyone welcome. Happy Diwali." (69)
- "Happy Diwali and Bandi Chhor Divas to all who mark them." (56)
- "Happy Diwali tonight, Saal Mubarak tomorrow." (44)
- "To colleagues, neighbours and the watchman who knows everyone's name: Happy Diwali." (83)
- "A quiet, safe and well-fed Diwali to everyone on this list." (59)

## What people actually post as a status, and why Diwali is different

A 2018 study of 86 WhatsApp status updates from 23 people in Indonesia, [published in the ICOMACS 2018 proceedings](https://www.atlantis-press.com/proceedings/icomacs-18/25900630), found 43.02% were assertives, or statements about the world. Expressives, statements of feeling, were 29.07%, and directives such as requests were 17.44%.

The sample is small and from one country, but an ordinary status there was more often a statement than a feeling. A Diwali greeting is an expressive by definition, and a feeling in your own words stands out in a feed of identical forwards.

Disappearing posts also change how people write. In [interviews with 25 Snapchat users](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC6169781) published at CSCW in 2016, default deletion encouraged everyday, mundane talk and reduced self-consciousness. A 24-hour status suits the joke about the late cousin, not the letter you want someone to keep.

## Who sees your Diwali status: three audience settings

By default a status goes to all your contacts, says WhatsApp's [status privacy help page](https://faq.whatsapp.com/502161774931737/). Under Status privacy you can choose My contacts, My contacts except… to leave people out, or Only share with… to name a short list.

A change to these settings does not affect a status already posted, so set it before the office group sees anything. Anyone you mention can see the status even outside your audience, and can reshare it. WhatsApp's [February 2023 announcement](https://blog.whatsapp.com/new-ways-to-enjoy-whatsapp-status) added a per-status audience choice, and your latest choice becomes the default for the next post.

## When to post a Diwali status in 2027

Lakshmi Puja falls on Friday 29 October 2027, with Dhanteras on Wednesday 27 October and Bhai Dooj on Sunday 31 October, per Drik Panchang's 2027 calendar for New Delhi. A status posted as the diyas are lit on Friday evening stays up through Saturday's Govardhan Puja.

A Diwali line posted on Dhanteras morning expires on Thursday, before the main night. To stay visible all five days, post a new short line each evening.

In our Raksha Bandhan 2026 data (n = 89, a small sample), only 6.7% of greeting pages were built four or more days ahead, so most people compose on the evening itself. Pick your line on Thursday 28 October and save it in a chat with yourself.

## Text, photo, video or voice: which status format to use

The table sets WhatsApp's four formats, per its help pages in October 2026, against a private SubhSandesh link. The limits are hard caps, so a 95-second aarti clip has to be trimmed.

| Format | Official limit | How long it stays up | Best Diwali use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Text status | No published character limit | 24 hours | One line from the lists above |
| Photo status | 2–6 photos per layout; HD not supported | 24 hours | Your rangoli or diyas with a short line |
| Video status | 90 seconds; 3GP or MPEG-4 | 24 hours | The diya-lighting or aarti, trimmed |
| Voice status | 30 seconds (announced February 2023) | 24 hours | Grandparents who prefer hearing you |
| Private SubhSandesh link | One recipient; 38.5% of creators add a password | Keeps working; 11.1 views per page on average | One person you want to wish properly |

The [create-a-status help page](https://faq.whatsapp.com/643144237275579/) adds that you cannot mention people in a text or voice status, only in photo and video ones. Only the link outlasts a day: a status reaches everyone briefly, a link reaches one person for as long as they want. If 30 seconds of voice is too short for one person, [Dedication, a radio show made for one listener](https://subhsandesh.in/dedication), lets them tune through static and hear your real voice introduce a song.

## When a status is the wrong way to say Happy Diwali

A status is a broadcast: it reaches your whole contact list for a day and asks nothing of anyone. It is the wrong tool for parents who never open the Updates tab, a partner in another city, or anyone you owe a real thank-you this year.

For that one person, SubhSandesh's [interactive Happy Diwali card](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-diwali) lets them light a diya at their door, light a row of wish diyas carrying your lines, colour a rangoli until your initials glow, and open your letter from a red-and-gold liffafa. It takes about five minutes to make, opens in any browser with no app or account, and its closing Shubh Deepavali card saves as a 1080×1920 image they can post as their own status.

It cannot post to WhatsApp status for you, and it is one page per person, not a broadcast. The template is new, so we have no Diwali usage data; the 11.1 views per page is platform-wide.
